messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty ALERT - HIGH: service=inference-gateway-eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=5% -> page fired: https://pagerduty.local/tickets/PD12345  

oncall_maya: acked — I'm on it. Starting triage (taking lead). Runbook link: #runbooks/inference-5xx

sre_eli: oncall_maya noted. Dashboard shows spike at 12:05 UTC, 3.0k RPS and ~8% 5xx over last 2m. Any recent deploys to eu-west?

eng_ops_jamie: Deploy pipeline shows no new production deploys in past hour. I see recent healthcheck changes for nginx sidecar rolled out to 10% canary earlier.

oncall_maya: rolling back nginx sidecar canary to 0% now to rule that out. Running quick health probe: `curl -I https://eu.api.redwood/v1/health` -> HTTP/1.1 502

sre_eli: runbook step 1: check kv-proxy and ingress LB. Running: `kubectl logs -l app=kvproxy -n eu | tail -n 80`

eng_ops_jamie: kvproxy logs showing a lot of `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` and `connection reset by peer` around 12:04-12:06.

oncall_maya: scaling kvproxy to 5 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/kvproxy --replicas=5 -n eu` — applying now.

carol_pm: Support alerted: 4 paying customers reported failures for embedding/batch endpoints. We should prepare a short customer note if this persists.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: If incident unmitigated in 15m, pager will escalate to SRE Lead.

sre_eli: also enabling fallback model route in eu region to reduce work on heavy model-hosts: `routing set-fallback inference -> model-compact eu-west1` (applied).

eng_ops_jamie: kvproxy pods are restarting but coming up cleanly. New pods not showing the reset errors.

oncall_maya: error rate trending down: 8% -> 4.1% -> 2.9% over last 6 minutes. Latency stable. Continuing to monitor.

carol_pm: noted. I've drafted a short triage message for support and queued to send if error rate >3% after 10m.

sre_eli: gathering full logs for RCA. I'll take post-incident ownership once we hit stable. Please attach `kvproxy` and `ingress-nginx` logs.

oncall_maya: grad update: traffic now routed around problematic LB backend via weight shift -> `lbctl set-weight eu-west1-backend-3 0.0` ; error rate now 1.2% (1m avg).

eng_ops_jamie: confirm: no deploy rollback needed beyond sidecar canary stop. No config rollbacks executed.

oncall_maya: handing off operational follow-up to @sre_eli for RCA and postmortem. I'll keep PD incident open for 30 more minutes and close if stable. :white_check_mark:

sre_eli: ack takeover. I'll collate logs, correlate with LB healthchecks, and start a timeline doc.

incidentbot: PagerDuty NOTE: escalation suppressed; incident still OPEN.

carol_pm: thanks team — customer comms standing by, will send if status doesn't reach <1% in 30m.

oncall_maya: final update for now: mitigation successful, monitoring for regressions. Closing PD page in 35m if stable.

sre_eli: collecting artifacts now — will post RCA draft in #postmortems/inference when ready.
